binary_fission: A way that tiny living things like bacteria make copies of themselves by splitting into two.
cell: The smallest part of a living thing that can work on its own. Like a tiny building block.
dna: Special instructions inside cells that tell them how to grow and work.
bacteria: Very small living things made of just one cell. Some can make you sick, but many are helpful.
reproduction: The way living things make more of their own kind.
asexual_reproduction: When one living thing makes a copy of itself without needing another living thing to help.
sexual_reproduction: When two living things (a mom and a dad) join together to make a baby.
cytoplasm: The jelly-like stuff inside a cell that holds all the parts together.
cell_membrane: The thin skin around a cell that keeps the inside parts in and lets some things pass through.
chromosome: A package of DNA that has many instructions for the cell.
mitosis: How bigger living things copy their cells to grow or heal.
fertilization: When a sperm cell from a dad joins with an egg cell from a mom to start making a baby.
